name: ctxjev-plugins
description: ctxjev — keeps what matters through Claude Code's own compaction, scored by Jev, no configuration required to start.

plugins.name: ctxjev
plugins.description: Scores your session's context with Jev right before Claude Code compacts it, then hands the highest-scoring entries back as a reminder the instant compaction finishes — so the detail that mattered most doesn't have to survive being summarized to still be there. Works automatically; /ctxjev:set-goal aims it at something specific, /ctxjev:status shows what's cached.
